messages:
sre-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: SEV2 deploy-sweeper-canary failures in us-west-2 · 5xx spike · page sent to oncall (josh). https://pdt.example/incident/ID-64321 :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: Incident ID ID-64321 · Trigger: healthcheck-fail · Affected service: sweeper · Symptom: 50% 503s on /v1/generate for canary group · Environment: prod-canary-usw2
josh (oncall): acked · I got the page, joining. Paging emily and maria for canary deploy context.
emily (runtime): on it, looking at canary cluster now. saw p95 generation latency spike then 5xxs start ~6432109800. pulling logs.
emily (runtime): logs (partial):
```
2026-03-15T20:03:05Z sweeper[pod-7]: kvcache miss spike, failed to allocate quantized kernel, OOM-ish error
2026-03-15T20:03:07Z sweeper[pod-7]: upstream-model: ERR transport timeout
2026-03-15T20:03:10Z sweeper[pod-9]: 503 - handler: inference_error: KV-cache invalidation race
```
josh (oncall): any recent config change? were we toggling dynamic-batching or kernel flags in this rollout?
maria (prod-eng): yes, this release enabled the new quant-path fallback + dynamic-batching tweak for RLHF models. We expected safer fallbacks but maybe a path regressed. rolling back flag now would be fastest.
emily (runtime): I can try diverting traffic off the canary pool to prod workers and mark canary as unhealthy in router. But if it's a code-level regression, rollback is safer.
anya (customer-success): heads-up — monitoring shows increased 503s from two paying customers (acme-inc, lumenai) starting ~20:03 UTC; seats affected: low but customer-facing incidents may start ~20:06 if sustained. cc @maria for comms.
josh (oncall): decision: initiate rollback of sweeper canary to previous revision and divert traffic. Maria, can you approve rollback? If yes, I'll run the rollback procedure. :thumbsup:
maria (prod-eng): approved. do rollback and drain canary. also capture a full heap/log dump from one of the failing pods before it terminates.
josh (oncall): running rollback now — command:```kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/sweeper-canary --to-revision=1242 && kubectl -n inference scale deploy/sweeper-canary --replicas=0 && curl -X POST https://router.svc/mark-unhealthy/canary-usw2```
emily (runtime): capturing logs/heap: `gcore` started on pod-7, uploading to s3://redwood-dumps/ID-64321/pod-7-gcore.tar.gz · link: https://s3.example/dumps/ID-64321
pagerduty-bot: ID-64321 · Acknowledged by josh (oncall) at 6432110020. Escalation paused.
sre-bot: Observability note: rolling median 5xx dropped from 48% -> 4% within 40s after diversion rule applied. Traces show redispatch to stable pool.
emily (runtime): rollback completed, canary scaled to 0, router mark-unhealthy returned 200. verifying steady state.
anya (customer-success): checking customer dashboards: acme-inc errors dropped to baseline within ~90s of rollback, reached out to account lead to say we're on it.
maria (prod-eng): pushing a quick postmortem task: collect diff between quant-path kernel selection between rev1243 (bad) and rev1242 (good). We need a hotfix if revert isn't root cause.
josh (oncall): PD incident update: ID-64321 set to resolved by josh at 6432110205. Root-cause investigation open, owning: emily + maria. Notifying SRE rotation for handoff.
pagerduty-bot: Incident ID-64321 resolved by josh (oncall) · Duration 6m:46s. Final status: mitigated (rollback) · Followup: RCA ticket #RCA-2561 created.
emily (runtime): quick notes for RCA: reproduce with load test + quant-path enabled; add extra KV-cache guard; consider backout in code path not just config. I'll attach heap/log artifacts to RCA.
maria (prod-eng): raising canary gating checks: add an additional p50/p95 tokenization regression monitor in canary pipeline + temp disable quant-path by default until kernel fallback validated.
josh (oncall): handing off to next oncall SRE (tom) for monitoring and RCA follow-up. @tom (oncall) please take the handoff — i've linked artifacts and the rollback timeline in RCA-2561. :white_check_mark:
anya (customer-success): I'll send a short customer note to Acme & LumenAI summarizing mitigation + ETA for follow-up.
sre-bot: Also note: autopager suppression prevented duplicate noisy pages at 20:04:12, only one page escalated after ack.
maria (prod-eng): thanks everyone. keeping thread open for any late telemetry, will post RCA draft in ~3 business days. :coffee:
